authorization: FROZEN 2026-11-17 at the owner's acceptance. Declares an antenna-on, OBSERVATION-ONLY 5.21 run for the Nooelec SMArt XTR SN 71874552 (E4000), UHF 400-470 MHz, gain 29.0 dB. `authorizes: true` means this declaration is the registered, accepted scope for such a run; it is NOT a launch authorization. The sequencer does not read this file yet, wiring is a separate slice, and a run still needs its own launch authorization (docs/521_CATALOGUE_AUTHORIZATION_DECISION.md). See docs/521_ANTENNA_ON_FREEZE_RECORD.md.
excluded_bands: 750 MHz, 881 MHz and FM (88-108 MHz) are outside this scope. With the load fitted the canary barely holds at 750/881 MHz (weakest visit 11.1 dB, one visit not detected, std 1.2-1.5 LSB), so antenna-on visits there would sit below the 11.0 dB floor. They stay out until the residue is understood and an antenna-on set there passes the gate.
mode_note: Antenna-on visits are scored for the receiver-spur canary and observed; no catalogue entry from them is promoted, and none is treated as a termination-grade reference.

receiver.description: Nooelec SMArt XTR, SN 71874552, Elonics E4000 tuner

termination.note: antenna on; the run makes no termination claim

gate.clip_limit_note: hard per-visit limit kept by the owner on 2026-11-16; revisit only with a measured clipping-vs-spur curve between 0.0005% and 0.015%

revalidation.method: one terminated session re-checks the frozen tier; full three-session re-derivation only if it fails

site: Operator states the venue at run time (operational field, not bound).
accepted_assumptions: MARGIN: the 11.0 dB visit floor leaves 0.6 dB at the weakest good antenna-on visit observed (Hwy 99, 11-14); at a degraded venue the margin is effectively zero. It affects how many visits are scored, not the tier.

GAIN: two of the tier's three sessions (RERUN2 2026-11-03, RERUN3 2026-11-11) declared 29.7 dB, an R820T2 step the E4000 does not have; the receiver clamped it and the effective gain was not read back. RERUN1 (2026-11-14) declared 29.0 dB, a valid E4000 step, and shows both offsets at occupancy 1.0.

BANDS: 401-435 MHz was refused in part at 2 of 5 venues tried (Hwy 99 11-15, Lynnwood 11-16), both cleared as antenna-side by load-fitted checks; a run there should expect refused tunings at some sites.
